data.title: 芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆】白色野花盛开的静谧墓园里，古旧的石十字架在清晨薄雾中静默伫立。芙莉莲在勇者的墓碑前驻足，指尖轻轻抚过冰冷的石面，绿色眼眸里流露追思。她想起旅途中新找到的魔法，也想起尚未说完的话。
data.action: 站在勇者墓碑前，以指尖轻触石面，安静追思
data.promptProse: Before Himmel's weathered memorial, Frieren rests her fingertips against the stone while holding her travel cloak's edge with the other hand. Reflective green eyes and pointed ears remain clear beside silver-white twintails in the medium view. Small white wildflowers grow at the base; crosses recede through morning mist. Soft daylight brightens the stone's upper face and her touching hand, preserving gentle shade where fingers meet its surface.
